info.title: CineCoin Unified API
info.description: Merged review contract based on original API v1.2.0, previous merged draft v1.3.1, interface Markdown v1.2, PRD v2.6.0 and confirmed Bootstrap decisions. Known source conflicts remain explicitly marked; schema validity is not business sign-off. v1.5.0 consolidates configuration reads into Bootstrap, reserves wheel configuration and four requested business operations, and unifies errors on message_pt. New placeholders do not define executable business contracts.

servers.description: Production address from supplied documentation; availability not verified.
Staging address from original contract; availability not verified.

tags.name: auth
tags.description:
身份与登录。Google 登录换取正式 token、token 续期与登出、当前用户资料、KYC 实名（占位）。
游客身份不在这里创建——由 `POST /v1/app/bootstrap` 首次调用时签发。

tags.name: content
tags.description:
短剧内容浏览。剧目列表与详情、分集、个性化 feed、播放地址。
内容实体来自第三方内容接口，这里只做鉴权、适配与播放源回退。

tags.name: config
tags.description:
配置读取（已收口）。仅保留提现页配置 `GET /v1/withdraw-page`；
区域 / 运行时 / 弹窗 / 转盘配置统一由 `POST /v1/app/bootstrap` 的 `config` 段下发，不要在这里新增配置接口。

tags.name: watch
tags.description:
观看与解锁。观看心跳上报、解锁报价、解锁扣费。
有效观看时长由心跳判定，是后续计币与礼包解冻的依据。

tags.name: ad
tags.description:
广告。广告位决策、曝光上报、激励视频 S2S 回调发奖。
广告是唯一变现路径，也是非付费用户金币的唯一来源。

tags.name: reward
tags.description:
奖励。可领奖励查询与领取。
奖励金额是固定业务规则，不进运行时配置，不能热更。

tags.name: wallet
tags.description:
账本与提现。余额、金币流水、提现档位与下单、提现进度与申诉、收款账户绑定。
金额一律以 moedas（整数）记账；汇率与提现档位是发布常量，不提供修改入口。

tags.name: task
tags.description: 任务与签到。任务列表、任务奖励领取、补签。

tags.name: popup
tags.description:
弹窗与策略。弹窗决策、弹窗队列推进、展示上报、通用策略决策。
弹窗的**配置**由 bootstrap 下发，这里只负责运行时决策与回传，不返回配置包。

tags.name: event
tags.description: 埋点上报。客户端事件批量上报，用于漏斗、留存与渠道对账。

tags.name: invite
tags.description: 邀请。邀请信息与分享素材、邀请关系绑定、邀请列表。

tags.name: product
tags.description: 商品与实物兑换。商品列表与详情、兑换、收货地址读写。

tags.name: bootstrap
tags.description:
App 冷启初始化，也是**配置下发的唯一入口**。身份 + 会话 + 四段配置 +
启动弹窗一次请求拿全；刷新时重新调用并携带 `config_versions`。

tags.name: admin
tags.description:
运营后台。广告与弹窗策略、实验、灰度发布、配置审计、看板。
面向运营人员，与客户端 `/v1/*` 分离，使用独立的后台鉴权（`AdminBearerAuth`）。

tags.name: wheel
tags.description:
转盘。当前仅预留结果查询 `GET /v1/wheel/results/{id}`；
转盘配置由 bootstrap 的 `config.wheel` 下发，奖池与概率规则待定。

post.description: SERVER-TO-SERVER ONLY. The supplied sources do not settle the real provider method, parameter encoding, signature/authentication scheme, replay window or acknowledgement body. security=[] only removes application BearerAuth; it MUST NOT be implemented as anonymous access. Keep this route disabled until a reviewed provider-verification adapter is installed. Duplicate verified events must not duplicate credit or settlement.

post.summary: Initialize identity, session, configuration and startup popup decisions
post.description:
Single cold-start entry point. No Authorization header: create a server-issued guest user/device/session once for this logical idempotent request. Valid backend guest or registered-user Bearer: restore that identity. A supplied malformed/expired/revoked Bearer must return 401, never fall through to anonymous creation. Never infer a registered session from device_id. Return identity, session, config and current startup deliveries only; no wallet/tasks/feed/unread aggregation. Config modules independently return updated or not_modified inside HTTP 200. Startup eligibility is always evaluated separately from config version. Cache-Control: no-store. Core identity and complete valid config requirements fail as an error, not a partially successful identity object; retries reuse the same key. Gift qualification/grant timing is C01, so the interface must not promise a grant just because it created a guest.

配置唯一入口：region、runtime、popups 全部由本接口下发，刷新时重新调用并携带 config_versions。新增 config.wheel 转盘配置占位，沿用独立版本比较与 HTTP 200 内 updated/not_modified；奖池、概率、消耗及资格等业务字段待定，本占位不代表转盘已可启用。

Version comparison is scoped to the selected app/region/locale/version/channel/set. Equal versions from different selection contexts cannot be treated as unchanged. Validate each whole module before persistence; use the last valid local data on network/config failure. Configuration revisions never reset reward eligibility or display history.

x-idempotency.first_install: Persist the request key securely before sending. Same request cannot create multiple guests or grant multiple gifts. Key entropy must be unpredictable; never reuse keys across installations.
x-idempotency.replay: Return the original identity/grant outcome; no repeated mutation. Session validity must still be checked. Retention and expired-session replay response need implementation approval.

post.description:
Use server-issued device_id bound to current authenticated session; it is not standalone proof. All data access and uniqueness constraints are scoped by app/user. Exact same successful logical request returns its original result; payload conflicts do not repeat mutations.

Google ID token is verified server-side and exchanged for a CineCoin session. Preserve original id_token/device_id/nonce request fields. Confirmed single-guest balance merge is max(account,guest), never addition. When existing account and guest conflict, require explicit user confirmation; the confirmation API is not supplied, so do not silently execute it. Do not reject all cross-device Google logins: PRD BF-03-04 permits up to three sessions (P1), with edge cases OPEN-12.

post.description: Revoke current authenticated session/refresh family without deleting ledger. An explicit subsequent guest entry uses Bootstrap. A guest logout must not silently erase access to its funds; UX confirmation/recovery remains OPEN-21.

post.description: Authenticate using the refresh_token in the body, not a still-valid access Bearer. Device ID is a binding check only. Rotate refresh token atomically. Expired/revoked refresh credentials require explicit session recovery; neither guests nor registered users silently become a new guest. Retry/rotation race and lost-response policy must be implemented without reusing a compromised credential.

double.daily_cap.description: PRD default 3. Allowed operational range is not defined in source; no invented upper bound.

RuntimeValues.description: Validate entire selected set, including rewarded + interstitial + appopen daily caps <= hard_cap. Values represent effective config; scheduled updates do not reset usage.

ConfigBundle.description: Bootstrap is the sole configuration delivery entry. Region, runtime, popups and wheel compare revisions independently. Invalid partial module data is never applied. Wheel business data is a provisional placeholder.

Startup.description: Return [] when no startup popup is eligible. Config not_modified never suppresses per-user startup reevaluation. Only welcome is a fully modeled startup payload in this version.

MergeResult.description: For confirmed eligible single-guest merge, final available=max(account_before,guest_before), delta=max(0,guest_before-account_before). No zero-value ledger entry. C02 governs other cases.

token.description: Backend access token, corresponds to bootstrap session.access_token.

PlayData.description: Release playback must be exact and licensed; demo/drama are retained for explicitly marked non-production demonstrations only. Expiry must be enforced by the serving CDN/proxy, not merely labeled.

HeartbeatData.description: Standard valid episode reward is 100, not stale 50. 60-89 second episodes require full duration; 90+ seconds require effective >=90s and coverage>=60%. Server receipt time and deduplicated media coverage determine credit.

UnlockQuoteData.description: C09 blocks activation; do not infer number of unlocked episodes from this legacy shape.

UnlockClaimData.description: Legacy shape retained; final one-versus-three-episodes contract is pending.

AdDecisionData.description: Decision is not reward proof. C14: concurrent decision/impression reservation lifecycle is not defined.

ImpressionData.description: Minimal acknowledgement added by this merge. Duplicate impression_id returns the original acknowledgement without another quota/revenue event.

formatted.description: pt-BR integer coin display, no currency symbol.

RewardOfferData.description: All amounts are the one moedas asset. incremental=target_total-already_granted, >=0. Only approved fixed reward rules, not arbitrary operator-defined cash/in-app ledgers. A multiplier offer uses 2.

RewardClaimData.description: Duplicates return first successful result. Server validates ownership and verified evidence; an offer ID is not permission to alter any amount.

available.description: BRL formatted text for withdrawal screen only.

pending.description: BRL formatted text for withdrawal screen only.

usd_hint.description: Approximate USD formatted text for withdrawal screen only.

gap_display.description: Optional cash label restricted to withdrawal view.

NextTier.description: gap_episodes is a server estimate based on eligible standard rewards, not a promise of eligibility or a fixed waiting period.

WalletData.description: Single ledger; available is SETTLED sum, pending is excluded. Do not reconstruct authority from UI/cache/animated values. Locked welcome accounting remains C01.

type.description: Server business type. Wheel types require an approved ledger extension; no fabricated unlock charge.

CoinSummary.description: Summary totals count SETTLED only. Display strings contain moedas, not cash. total_in-total_out equals available balance, pending rows do not contribute.

CoinListData.description: Page total counts entries, not groups; a date may span pages. No seven-day truncation.

LedgerEntry.description: Only append corrections. REVERSAL requires reverses_ledger_id and cannot be repeated. PENDING does not alter available balance.

Withdrawal.description: All six business states are preserved. A four-step progress UI is only presentation, not a new four-state order machine.

AccelerationData.description: No newbie channel. Each channel.days is actual applied savings, not unconstrained nominal awards; sum equals total_saved and never exceeds 12. C05 blocks activation decisions.

WithdrawProgressData.description: ETA calculated server-side using approved business calendar. No state transitions caused merely by ETA expiry. PAID => days_left=0; all terminal orders disable acceleration.

accelerated_cap.description: Legacy field means number of people, not days. Prefer explicit label; overall savings cap remains 12 days.

InviteInfoData.description: PRD 5.5 documents 20/month; 5.12 defines lifetime settle_max default 50. Eligibility should not be confused with ability to share. C10 settlement/copy conflict remains.

InviteRecord.description: PENDING has coins=0 and settled_at=null; do not expose invitee phone/email/device identifiers.

InviteBindData.description: Preview is nullable while invitee welcome amount is unresolved. Binding creates a relationship, not an automatic reward grant.

InviteShareData.description: Copy must match approved actual eligibility. Do not reuse the stale 1000-coin invitee promise.

Product.description: Wheel fulfillment only, not a coin store. Internal cost_budget_usd is never returned.

ProductDetail.description: Expiry/delivery terms are source-draft proposals (C11), not silently approved hardcoded service promises.

GiftRedeemData.description: Same win_id always returns same order without duplicate inventory/debit; conflicting payload is 409.

cep.description: 8 位数字，可用 ViaCEP 校验

TaskId.description: Use exactly the ID returned by /v1/tasks. Known source IDs include T_SIGN,T_AD5,T_SHARE,T_INV1,T_FAV1 and conflicting T_EP10/T_EP3. Do not infer target from the suffix. C03 requires catalog/alias sign-off.

TaskListData.description: GET is read-only. Ganhar automatic check-in invokes the existing POST /task/claim with the active T_SIGN; do not award again on list refresh. Separate +150 completion-task catalog remains C03.

TaskClaimReq.description: Idempotency scope includes authenticated app/user + task occurrence + business date, not globally task_id+date. Invitation grant is not duplicated by claiming its task.

TaskClaimData.description: streak is relevant only to sign-in. Duplicate claims return the initial success.

trans_id.description: Verified ad completion owned by current user; no reuse across claims.

PopupDecisionData.description: At most one immediate action; queued IDs are not permission to open simultaneous modals.

PopupReportData.description: Acknowledgement added by merge. Repeated lifecycle event IDs are no-ops. A shown/completed report is not a monetary proof.

EventsBatchData.description: Acknowledgement added by merge; atomic validation rejects malformed batch before enqueue. Client cannot assert trusted backend origin.

StrategyData.description: Second-phase source contract; reward values must not override release constants.

WithdrawPageData.description: Server-assigned device-stable bucket for 30 days. Only layout/copy may vary, not money, tiers, rate, SLA or KYC.

ProvisionalAdminPayload.description: Unspecified in supplied source. This is an explicit gap, not an arbitrary accepted production payload.

ProvisionalAdminData.description: Detailed admin response missing from source; retained only to preserve route inventory.

ExperimentVariantSummary.description: Revenue/cost/net-contribution currency/precision not specified; keep out of typed properties until agreed.

Unauthorized.description: Invalid or expired credentials. Refresh or explicitly reauthenticate; never silently downgrade or recreate a guest.

Forbidden.description: Not authorized for this resource or action.

example.message_pt: Limite atingido. Tente novamente mais tarde

x-open-issues.title: Welcome grant timing and locked-ledger semantics
x-open-issues.source: PRD BF-01-04 says registration; previous Bootstrap draft assumed guest creation grants coins; ledger only defines SETTLED/PENDING.
x-open-issues.handling: Do not infer an unconditional grant from guest creation. Bootstrap returns actual reward state. First-guest example uses not_granted, not a fictitious credit. Registration trigger and locked funds accounting require approval.

x-open-issues.title: Guest merge edge cases and confirmation protocol
x-open-issues.source: PRD BF-03-02 and OPEN-12; Markdown 5.2 adds guest balance, contradicting max.
x-open-issues.handling: For the confirmed single-guest merge use max, never sum. Existing-account conflicts require user confirmation. Multi-device, locked/pending migration and confirmation wire protocol remain blocked; do not auto-merge them.

x-open-issues.title: Daily task catalog and legacy task identifier
x-open-issues.source: PRD BF-07-03 has check-in-completion task +150; PRD 5.5 and JSON have T_FAV1; PRD/JSON use T_EP10 for three episodes, Markdown uses T_EP3.
x-open-issues.handling: Task IDs remain server-issued strings; retain known legacy IDs in documentation without silently renaming or adding a second reward. Freeze catalog and alias migration before implementation.

x-open-issues.title: Make-up reward and welcome double quota
x-open-issues.source: PRD BF-07-02 grants make-up reward and double; 5.5 says no duplicate coins. BF-07-07 does not explicitly include welcome bonus in daily double cap.
x-open-issues.handling: Keep weekly make-up limit and server verification. No hardcoded make-up coin amount or welcome double.daily_cap binding until confirmed.

x-open-issues.title: Ad-related withdrawal acceleration conflicts with domain boundary
x-open-issues.source: PRD BF-06-14 versus 5.11 prohibitions; BF-01-04 explicitly removes welcome acceleration.
x-open-issues.handling: Remove newbie -3 days. Preserve documented ad/invite acceleration response fields as review-required, not automatically enabled. Do not resolve the 5.11 conflict through copy changes.

x-open-issues.title: R04 fund handling conflicts with refund invariants
x-open-issues.source: PRD 5.3 R04 freezes funds; BF-06-05/08 and 5.3 state transitions refund rejected/failed orders and protect earned balance.
x-open-issues.handling: Keep reason R04 but block an implementation-specific debit/freeze exception until approved. Do not change balances solely from a client error code.

x-open-issues.title: Provider callback authentication and wire format
x-open-issues.source: PRD OPEN-11; original JSON and Markdown carry unverified callback parameters/HMAC formula.
x-open-issues.handling: Reserve callback paths as disabled integration stubs. Remove purported fixed signature, parameter and timestamp contracts. Actual provider-authenticated adapters must be specified before activation.

x-open-issues.title: Content license metadata and playback protection
x-open-issues.source: PRD BF-11-03 requires license metadata; Markdown 3.4 allows temporarily not filtering; upstream actual interface not independently verified.
x-open-issues.handling: Production BFF must use verified license registry/allowlist or withhold content. MP4/HLS supported as adapter outputs; expires_at alone does not secure an upstream permanent URL.

x-open-issues.title: Unlock amount and unrestricted-content rule
x-open-issues.source: Original JSON says one ad unlocks one episode; PRD BF-02-04 says three episodes, appendix says no content lock.
x-open-issues.handling: Retain original unlock routes/quote IDs. Mark feature disabled pending conflict resolution; do not freeze either one or three as an approved rule.

x-open-issues.title: Invitation settlement and invitee welcome amount
x-open-issues.source: PRD BF-08-02 says first valid episode but also T+1; examples say first withdrawal; invitee +1000 conflicts with welcome 50000.
x-open-issues.handling: Use documented first-episode qualification in schema descriptions, but exact settlement timing and invitee amount remain open. No duplicated welcome +1000 or silently paid task reward.

x-open-issues.title: Gift expiry, delivery promise and inventory allocation
x-open-issues.source: Markdown 10 supplies 7-day claim/30-business-day delivery; PRD does not freeze detailed fulfillment policy.
x-open-issues.handling: Retain as documented draft terms, not universal defaults. Stock reservation at win time, compensation and fulfillment-status lookup are missing.

x-open-issues.title: Incomplete admin write/read contracts
x-open-issues.source: Markdown 14 lists route groups but not complete schemas; prior draft inferred item-level PUT paths.
x-open-issues.handling: Keep routes as provisional, with explicit incomplete schemas and source routing notes. Do not generate production handlers until admin contracts are approved.

x-open-issues.title: Missing or placeholder-only business contracts
x-open-issues.source: PRD includes wheel, KYC/payment binding, history/favorites, appeals, account deletion/export, settings; source JSON lacks full contracts.
x-open-issues.handling: Wheel configuration is reserved in Bootstrap; wheel result, KYC, payout account binding and withdrawal appeal routes are placeholders only. Detailed contracts remain open. Wheel spin submission, user-feature and other uncovered contracts remain missing; do not infer implementation readiness.

x-open-issues.title: Ad decision concurrency and proof binding
x-open-issues.source: GET ad/decision plus later impression has no atomic reservation/redeem contract; reward proof references supplied by client.
x-open-issues.handling: Require server-side trusted evidence and idempotency. Reservation lifecycle and whether double ad also grants base +50 remain open.

x-open-issues.title: Session and config-context lifecycle
x-open-issues.source: Prior Bootstrap has no session_id for dependent popup/event requests; numerical config versions can collide between regions or sets.
x-open-issues.handling: Add session_id and describe it as a design clarification. Cache matching must include app/region/locale/version/channel selection; allocate unique selected-package revisions or reset local versions on context change. All configuration comparisons now use Bootstrap, including the provisional wheel module; there are no standalone config read paths.

x-source-precedence: Confirmed conversation decisions: sole POST /v1/app/bootstrap; no independent anonymous login; per-module not_modified with HTTP 200.
Explicit latest PRD v2.6.0 revision notes override older examples only when the override is unambiguous.
Otherwise preserve original JSON + interface Markdown terminology and mark contradictions for review.
Previous v1.3.1 generic placeholders do not override more specific original request fields.

x-contract-conventions.timestamps: UTC integer int64 milliseconds; business dates in America/Sao_Paulo.
x-contract-conventions.money: Integer moedas; COIN_RATE=10000 BRL conversion, fx=5 for approximate USD, no dual asset ledger.
x-contract-conventions.config: Bootstrap only: region, runtime, popups and wheel are independently versioned modules with updated/version/data versus not_modified/version. No standalone config reads or transport-level conditional caching. Wheel business data is a placeholder.
x-contract-conventions.security: All user endpoints require backend Bearer except first-use Bootstrap and refresh credential exchange. A bad supplied Bearer is not equivalent to no Bearer. Callbacks are disabled placeholders pending real provider verification.
x-contract-conventions.idempotency: Exact duplicate mutations return original result; same key with a different intent is conflict. Money/event uniqueness cannot expire at 60 seconds.
x-contract-conventions.authority: Client context/identifiers/callback hints do not prove rewards or payment completion.
x-contract-conventions.readiness: Structure-reviewed does not mean all source business rules are approved. x-contract-status/x-open-issues are review metadata, not automatically enforced gateway rules.
x-contract-conventions.errors: All errors use ApiError: code, message_pt, retryable, data and request_id. Successful response envelopes retain message.

x-coverage-gaps.missing: Bootstrap wheel configuration and wheel result query are placeholders only. Prize list, spin transaction, result details/recovery and inventory reservation contracts remain undefined; cost conflict 20 vs 500 remains unresolved.
KYC and payout account binding routes are reserved, but payloads and behavior remain undefined. Google merge confirmation and session lifecycle edge-case contracts remain missing.
History, favorites, preference changes, account deletion/data export remain missing. Withdrawal appeal route is reserved, with its detailed contract pending.
Atomic quota reservation/show authorization and client-visible verified reward status/recovery endpoint.
Gift order list/detail and shipment tracking endpoints.

ImpressionData, PopupReportData and EventsBatchData acknowledgement shapes are new explicit merge design; source only said success.
session.session_id plus popup delivery_id/event_id connect existing endpoints and deduplication. Session/frequency lifecycle needs C15 review.
Removed public risk_flag internals, restricted public event_source to client, and treated masked payout account fields as summaries, not credentials.
Runtime and popup updated results now use the same data property as region. This replaces prior flattened values/items results.
